title.rendered: An Update on Product Availability at Cannabis Connection

content.rendered:
Dear Cannabis Connection customers,

We want to keep you in the loop about the ongoing BCLDB (BC Liquor Distribution Branch) strike and how it could affect your experience with us here in Chilliwack.

As the sole distributor of cannabis products in BC, the BCLDB plays a big role in getting products from licensed producers to local shops like ours. When job action happens at their end, it can lead to delays and changes in what you see on our shelves.

What this could mean for you:

  • Product availability: Some favourites may sell out faster or be temporarily unavailable.
  • Menu changes: Our selection may shift as we adapt to supply interruptions.
  • Potential slowdowns: While we’ll always work hard to serve you quickly, you might notice occasional service delays.

What we’re doing to support you:

  • Carefully managing our stock so you still have a variety of options.
  • Sourcing more products from local direct delivery companies to keep our shelves full and support BC growers.
  • Staying in close touch with suppliers and partners to keep quality high.
  • Updating our online menu frequently, so you can check availability before making the trip.
  • Ensuring our team is up to date, so they can answer your questions in-store.

We know how important consistency is—whether you’re stopping by for your go-to strain, exploring edibles, or stocking up for the weekend. Chilliwack’s cannabis community deserves transparency, and we’re committed to keeping you informed every step of the way.

We appreciate your patience and loyalty as we navigate this situation together. Thanks for choosing Cannabis Connection as your trusted local cannabis retailer—we’ll share updates as the strike continues.

– The Cannabis Connection Team
